Package guiLessonsList

package guiLessonsList

The guiLessonsList package holds the Lessons Learned list page, the page a contributor reaches from the Lessons Learned button on the Role1 and Role2 home pages.

It follows the Model-View-Controller split of the supplied GUI packages. ViewLessonsList builds the widgets once and shows the page; ControllerLessonsList reacts to the search box, the category filter, the "Only my lessons" box, and the buttons; ModelLessonsList holds the list of every lesson and decides which lessons are shown and what the status line says. Unlike the supplied Models, which are empty, this Model holds data, because the page narrows a list and has to explain the result. The Model contains no JavaFX, so its decisions are tested directly by testingAutomation.LessonsModelTestingAutomation.

Contributor stories implemented here: CS-2 (see all lessons, newest first, with an empty list explained in words), CS-3 (open the selected lesson), CS-4 (search), CS-5 (filter by category), CS-6 (only my lessons), and the entry point to CS-1 (New Lesson).
